First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Spirited; ends with a sprint at the railroad tracks sign. It’s a drop ride: if you can’t hold the pace, you’ll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

First group ride? Start here →

About the 38 Special group ride

38 Special is a road group ride in Bozeman, MT. It rolls every Saturday at 9:00 am from Kelly Canyon Rd and the I-90 frontage road, at the Kelly Canyon railroad tracks. It’s on its seasonal break now.

A fast Saturday road ride over Kelly Canyon Rd, up Bridger Canyon Rd and along the frontage road to the top of Bozeman Pass, then back. It is a drop ride with regroups at Bridger Canyon Rd, the top of Jackson Creek and the top of the pass.
